title: Ambedkar Memorial Park, Lucknow - A Grand Symbol of Social Justice
content:
Ambedkar Memorial Park, Lucknow

Ambedkar Memorial Park is one of the most impressive and unique monuments in Lucknow, Uttar Pradesh. Located in Gomti Nagar, this vast park is dedicated to Dr. B. R. Ambedkar, the chief architect of the Indian Constitution, and other social reformers who worked for equality and justice. With its massive sandstone structures, statues, and beautifully planned spaces, the park stands as a symbol of dignity, empowerment, and modern architecture.

Spread over a huge area, Ambedkar Memorial Park is not just a tourist attraction but also a place of learning, reflection, and pride.

History & Purpose

The park was developed in the early 21st century to honor the lives and contributions of Dr. B. R. Ambedkar, Kanshi Ram, and other leaders of social change. The idea behind the memorial was to create a space that celebrates the values of social justice, equality, and democracy.

Today, it is among the largest memorial parks in India and a major landmark of Lucknow.

Architecture & Highlights

Ambedkar Memorial Park is known for its grand architecture made of red sandstone, similar to that used in historic monuments.

Key Attractions:

  • Dr. Ambedkar Statue - a majestic bronze statue of Babasaheb
  • Kanshi Ram Memorial - honoring the BSP founder
  • Pratibimb Sthal - gallery of statues of social reformers
  • Rashtriya Dalit Prerna Sthal - memorial with pillars and domes
  • Grand Plazas & Pathways - vast open areas with symmetrical design
  • Water Bodies & Fountains - adding beauty and calmness

The scale and symmetry of the park give visitors a feeling of walking through a modern-day monument complex.

Ambedkar Park in the Evening

In the evening, the park is beautifully lit, and the warm lights on red sandstone create a magical atmosphere. Many visitors prefer to come at sunset to enjoy the cool breeze, lighting, and peaceful surroundings.

Location & How to Reach

Ambedkar Memorial Park is located in Gomti Nagar, Lucknow, near the Gomti River.

  • By Road: Easily reachable by cab, auto, and city buses
  • Nearest Metro: Indira Nagar / Gomti Nagar area stations (depending on route)
  • From Charbagh Railway Station: 9-10 km
  • From Airport: -15-18 km

Timings & Entry Fee

Timings: Usually 11:00 AM to 9:00 PM

Entry Fee:

  • Indians: Around ₹20
  • Foreigners: Around ₹300
  • Children: Free/nominal

(Timings and fees may change.)

Best Time to Visit

  • October to March: Best season with pleasant weather
  • Evening hours: Ideal for lights and photos
  • Avoid very hot afternoons in summer.

Nearby Places to Visit

  • Gomti Riverfront
  • Janeshwar Mishra Park
  • Hazratganj Market 
  • Indira Dam
  • Bara Imambara & Rumi Darwaza (a bit farther)

Why Visit Ambedkar Memorial Park?

Ambedkar Memorial Park is not just about beauty; it carries a strong message of equality and respect. Its massive structures, peaceful environment, and historical importance make it a must-visit place for anyone exploring Lucknow.
